market_outlook.short_term: High volatility regime driven by US-Iran escalation and oil-driven inflation. Expect 5-8% equity swings. Bond yields rise further. Fed on hold but markets punish inaction. Tech bifurcates: AI leaders resilient, laggards (Credo, Palo Alto) volatile. Nikkei/semiconductors most exposed. Crypto remains risk-off. 1-3 month: range-bound with upside capped by oil, downside limited by AI earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (Nvidia, South Korea $15.5B, data centers) supports 6-12 month equity upside if geopolitical risk normalizes. Energy transition (China solar, renewables) creates structural winners. India capital-markets deepening offers EM alpha. Apple-OpenAI IP resolution will set AI regulation precedent. Venezuela oil, if executed, adds 1-2M bpd over 2-3 years, easing supply. Key risk: prolonged war keeps inflation sticky, forcing ECB/BOJ higher and pressuring global growth.
